description: Na₆MnCl₈ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MnCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are two shorter (2.78 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. Mn²⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Cl¹⁻ atoms to form MnCl₆ octahedra that share edges with twelve equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. All Mn-Cl bond lengths are 2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to six equivalent Na¹⁺ atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra and edges with twelve equivalent ClNa₄Mn square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Mn²⁺ atom to form ClNa₄Mn square pyramids that share corners with nine equivalent ClNa₄Mn square pyramids, edges with four equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent ClNa₄Mn square pyramids.
